page_types.manufacturer_product_page: A robot maker's own site or page describing robots it makes or sells (including its own product, solution, or docs pages).
page_types.news_press: News, blog, or press coverage about robots or companies, written by a publisher rather than the maker of the robots described.
page_types.buyer_corporate_site: The site of an organization that is not a robot maker, such as a company that buys or operates robots, or any other business.
page_types.directory_or_multi_company: A directory, list, marketplace, or comparison of products from many different companies.
